title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in more than one source (PCMag, Rtings, Tom’s Guide, Consumer Reports).
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a small living room where you want a Sonos‑style speaker that also looks like a shelf. The Ikea Symfonisk delivers clear, bright sound with good bass for under $100, making it ideal for budget‑conscious users who want a stylish, multi‑room option. The catch: it has no Bluetooth and can distort on deep bass at high volumes.
